sources.snippet: nabinkhair/genui-vl-8b-merged architecture at a glance nabinkhair/genui-vl-8b-merged is a model (qwen3_vl_text architecture). It uses 36 transformer layers, a hidden size of 4,096, and 32 query heads with 8 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 12,288.
